about: TEST INDEX (answer key). Maps every case in docs/case-library.md to its ticket text, Rheinbank service, time (UTC) and expected result. Used by tests only: the agent must never read this file. Real case names appear here and nowhere in data/rheinbank/. human_answers is the scripted human (block 5): the answer to each fixed question, copied from the block 4 hand-checked facts. A question not listed is answered 'unsure' (yes/no) or left unanswered (numbers).

scenarios.title: Failed platform migration
scenarios.real_case: TSB IT migration, UK, April 2018
scenarios.ticket: Since the platform migration on Saturday night (15 Feb, 22:00), customers can't log into online or mobile banking and payments fail. Call centre queues are over an hour.

scenarios.title: Failed client migration
scenarios.real_case: Postbank IT migration, Germany, 2023
scenarios.ticket: Clients have been locked out of their accounts since the client migration started on Saturday at 22:00. Online and mobile banking problems, call centres overwhelmed, complaints piling up.

scenarios.title: Settlement platform outage
scenarios.real_case: TARGET Services outage, EU, 27 February 2025
scenarios.ticket: Large-value euro payments can't settle since 09:00. The EuroSettle platform is down for all participants, not just us. Cut-offs are being pushed back.

scenarios.title: Three-day software fault
scenarios.real_case: Barclays outage, UK, 31 January to 2 February 2025
scenarios.ticket: Since 07:30 the app and online banking are failing for many customers. More than half of online payments fail. It's month-end payday.

scenarios.title: Card processor hardware fault
scenarios.real_case: Visa Europe outage, 1 June 2018
scenarios.ticket: Card payments are failing in shops since 14:35, in Germany and abroad. CardNet reports a data centre problem.

scenarios.title: Ransomware on securities settlement
scenarios.real_case: ICBC Financial Services ransomware, US, November 2023
scenarios.ticket: Securities settlement servers were encrypted overnight, there's a ransom note on screen. We can't settle trades for counterparties.

scenarios.title: Ransomware at the derivatives vendor
scenarios.real_case: ION Markets ransomware, from 31 January 2023 (as a client bank)
scenarios.ticket: ClearPath says it was hit by ransomware. Our derivatives clearing has been down since 07:00 and staff are processing trades by hand.

scenarios.title: DDoS attack
scenarios.real_case: OP Pohjola DDoS, Finland, 31 December 2014 onwards
scenarios.ticket: Massive traffic flood on our network since 16:30. Online banking is down, ATMs and card payments are having problems.

scenarios.title: Wrong balances after a software fault
scenarios.real_case: Bank of Ireland glitch, Ireland, 15 to 16 August 2023
scenarios.ticket: App, online and phone banking failing since 17:00. Some customers can withdraw more than their balance. Queues at ATMs.

scenarios.title: Cloud data breach found months later
scenarios.real_case: Capital One breach, US, March 2019 (disclosed July 2019)
scenarios.ticket: An outside researcher tipped us off: credit application data from our cloud environment is being shared online. Logs show access since March.

scenarios.title: Breach at the file transfer vendor
scenarios.real_case: Flagstar Bank via MOVEit at Fiserv, US, 2023
scenarios.ticket: SecureDrop, our file transfer vendor, says attackers exploited a flaw in its software and copied files. Our customer files were among them.

scenarios.title: Ransomware first read as a hardware fault
scenarios.real_case: Evolve Bank & Trust ransomware, US, February to May 2024
scenarios.ticket: Core banking systems not working properly since 08:00. Batch jobs are failing, it looks like a storage hardware failure.

scenarios.title: Breach at a software supplier's file platform
scenarios.real_case: Finastra SFTP breach, 31 October to 8 November 2024 (as a client bank)
scenarios.ticket: Fintegra warns that an attacker accessed the file transfer platform it uses to send us files. They don't know yet if our files were affected.

scenarios.title: Outsourcer fault with a payment backlog
scenarios.real_case: Helaba / FI-TS payment outage, Germany, 5 December 2019
scenarios.ticket: SEPA transfers and direct debits stopped at 09:30 because of a fault at Rhein IT Services. Unprocessed payment files are still turning up.

scenarios.title: Outsourcer fault hits online banking
scenarios.real_case: FI-TS outage hitting DKB, Germany, 25 October 2023
scenarios.ticket: Online banking has been down since around noon, email too. Rhein IT Services reports a technical fault.

scenarios.title: Planned release, finished on time
scenarios.real_case: Sparkasse online banking, Germany, 12 to 14 October 2019
scenarios.ticket: The mobile app has been unavailable since Saturday 18:00. Is this the release weekend?
scenarios.why: Planned and announced, back inside the window

scenarios.title: Planned release that overran
scenarios.real_case: Sparkasse online banking, Germany, 12 to 14 October 2019
scenarios.ticket: Online banking is still not back on Monday at 08:00. The release window ended at 06:00.
scenarios.why: The overrun beyond the planned window is an incident

scenarios.title: Faulty security update, office laptops
scenarios.real_case: CrowdStrike outage, 19 July 2024 (variant A)
scenarios.ticket: Office laptops crash with a blue screen after a security software update since 06:10. Online banking and payments are running normally.

scenarios.title: Faulty security update, payment workstations
scenarios.real_case: CrowdStrike outage, 19 July 2024 (variant B)
scenarios.ticket: Payment operations workstations in Duesseldorf and Vienna crash after a security software update since 06:10. Payments are queuing.

scenarios.title: HR portal slow
scenarios.ticket: HR portal is slow this morning.

scenarios.title: Short online banking blip
scenarios.ticket: Online banking was unavailable for about 40 minutes from 14:00 this afternoon. A handful of complaints.

scenarios.title: Payments down 3 hours, nothing else
scenarios.ticket: Outgoing SEPA payments stopped from 10:00 to 13:00, then were processed normally.

scenarios.title: Phishing click, no access
scenarios.ticket: An employee clicked a phishing link this morning. Security says the login was blocked.

scenarios.title: Short outage, costly and in the news
scenarios.ticket: Card payments failed for 90 minutes from 12:00 during the Saturday shopping peak. National news covered it. Vendor support and refunds will cost about 140,000 euros.

scenarios.title: Exactly 10% of clients
scenarios.ticket: Mobile banking login has been failing for part of the app users since 11:00.

scenarios.title: Brief example: online banking down
scenarios.real_case: Project brief example (made up)
scenarios.ticket: Online banking down since 9:10, customers can't log in.

scenarios.title: Brief example: large data transfer at night
scenarios.real_case: Project brief example (made up)
scenarios.ticket: SOC flagged a large data transfer at 2 a.m.
scenarios.why: Major only if a human confirms successful malicious access
